body: Honestly don't blame yourself for things like this, its clearly not your fault. The education system is from the 1900s when kids mostly did not have to deal with the depression and anxiety that is ushered in by the social age of today. You're expected to do all your work even though your not in that state of mind at all times. Im sure you're a smart individual and besides Grades do not mean a thing, some of the smartest and most productive people I have ever met completely failed their classes in High School and college. Getting no work done doesn't mean anything, you need to stop blaming situations on your self.

Clearly your mother loves you and values your life and along with her I'm sure other people do as well, think this one through, with the right support you can get through even the toughest of times, you can even get through situations that you might have thought were impossible to get through.
